{
  "output_quality": {"score": 3, "reason": "Recognizable cartoon construction scene: sky, clouds, bird, dirt pile, excavator arm and wheels, caution cone. But the sloth operator is not clearly readable, forms are simple, and the excavator is cramped/clipped at the right edge."},
  "instruction_following": {"score": 2, "reason": "Single self-contained file, correct 1200x800 viewBox, no externals or JS, and scenery mostly present. But the sloth is illegible and nearly all SMIL animations sit unattached inside <defs>, so the digging cycle, steering, track rolling and blinking never run - fewer than four elements actually animate."},
  "creativity": {"score": 3, "reason": "A charming concept (sleepy sloth in hard hat and hi-vis on an excavator, floating Zzz, sky bird), but it is executed generically with straightforward cartoon shapes and conventional composition; little inventive detail or unexpected motion."},
  "animation_fidelity": {"score": 2, "reason": "Clouds drift, the bird crosses, and the Zzz floats upward, but those are the only motions that work. The boom/stick/bucket dig, steering wheel, track rollers and sloth blink are defined in <defs> with no target, so they are inert; the core digging cycle does not cycle."},
  "richness_detail": {"score": 3, "reason": "Twelve gradients plus layered ground, dirt mounds, clouds, excavator, cones and a bird give some depth, yet the rendered scene reads flat and sparse; shading and detail do not translate into visual richness."},
  "composition_aesthetics": {"score": 3, "reason": "A clean sky-over-ground split with the excavator on the right, but the machine is crowded and clipped at the edge and the sloth is illegible; colors are harmonious but the layout lacks focus and polish."},
  "summary": "A valid single SVG with the right subject and canvas, but most SMIL animations are unattached in <defs> so the digging and character motion fail, and the sloth operator is not clearly rendered."
}
